_help: How colorize_set_symbol.py paints the colored set symbols set_<code>_<rarity>.svg (after download.py choice 3).
These files are the symbols of the set symbol dataset (set_symbol_data_set.py).
Change it, then run colorize_set_symbol.py: the files drawn with another paint are drawn again
(and the dataset is built again, its symbols changed).
A symbol has 3 areas: 'symbol' (the black parts of the scryfall SVG), 'inner' (the holes of the SVG,
filled unless 'none') and 'outline' (the border around it).
Each area gets a paint:
'rarity': the rarity color of the class (rarity_colors, a gradient dark -> light -> dark),
'rarity_white': the same as 'rarity', but white (colors.white) for a common (and before Exodus),
'line': the line color of the rarity (line_colors: white for a common, black for the others),
a color of "colors" ('white', 'black', 'gray'...: add one there to use it), or 'none'
(outline and inner only: not drawn, transparent: no border, holes that show the background).
An area is either one paint ('rarity') or a choice with weights ({"white": 1, "rarity": 2}): the paint
with the biggest weight is used.
styles: the named styles, a paint for each area (and optionally min_inner: the style is only used when the
inner area is at least this share of the symbol, else the rarity color could be invisible):
black_hold_rarity__outline_black (the default style): the black of the SVG holds the rarity (black, silver,
gold, orange), the transparent holds the background, as the outline (white, black, black, black),
black_hold_rarity: the same, but a white outline for every rarity,
inner_hold_rarity: the invert, the transparent holds the rarity, the black of the SVG the background
(white, black, black, black), no outline (fra, fin),
inner_hold_rarity_white: a black symbol, the inner area holds the rarity, white for a common, no outline (msc),
black_hold_rarity_and_invert: the black of the SVG holds the rarity, the inner area is white for every rarity,
the outline as black_hold_rarity (white, black, black, black), gaps closed (close_gaps), a thin black line
inside the edge of the symbol (inline) (pip),
black_hold_rarity__inline_black: the black of the SVG holds the rarity, a thin black line inside its edge
(inline, inline_width), the holes and around it transparent: no inner area, no outline (mat),
black_rarity_none: the symbol stays black, the inner area holds the rarity, no outline (csp),
black_symbol: the symbol stays black, the inner area and the outline hold the rarity (dft),
old: before Exodus, the 1993 frame (arn, atq, leg, drk, vis): a black symbol, white inner area, no outline,
old_thin_border: before Exodus (fem, ice, all): a black symbol, white inner area, a thin white outline,
black_gray: a black symbol, gray inner area, a thin gray outline (hml).
outline_width (optional, in a style): the outline width, times the usual one (1.1 px when the symbol is 27 px
high): 1 by default, 0.5 = half (thin), at most 3.
close_gaps (optional, in a style, false by default): true = the gaps of the symbol up to twice the outline are
closed, the regions they then enclose are inner area too (pip: the face of Vault Boy, open beside the ears).
inline (optional, in a style, no key = no line): a paint ('black', 'white', 'line', 'rarity'...): a thin line
inside the edge of the symbol area (the black of the SVG: its outer edge and the edge of its holes), as the
outline but inside; the parts of the symbol thinner than twice the line are all in this paint.
inline_width (optional, in a style with an inline): its width, times the usual outline: 0.5 by default (0.56 px
when the symbol is 27 px high), at most 3.
set (optional, in a style): the set codes that use this style, ex: ["csp"]. It comes before anything else
(sets.<code>.style, style), so a set code is in the "set" of one style only.
style: the style of every set (a name, or a choice with weights {"black_hold_rarity": 2, ...}: the usable
one with the biggest weight).
Before Exodus, common, uncommon and rare are drawn, all 3 in the colors of a common.
sets: what is different for some sets (by their code), each key optional:
rarity_colors, line_colors: replace those of some rarities only,
style: replace the default style for the set (unless the set is in the "set" of a style).
dom (Dominaria, 2018): the common is white with a black outline (its rarity color is white, its line black).
dft (Aetherdrift): black_symbol, white for a common.
Colors are RGB 0-255. "colors" must have white and black (line_colors, rarity_white), its other colors are
optional (a line_colors value is one of them too).
